docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY SCHLESINGER KENNETH AS TO DEFENDANT FORTUNE AMERICA INC/XIAN GAO PRESIDENT ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-02-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 02
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT FORTUNE AMERICA INC/XIAN GAO PRESIDENT
CLAIM OF DEFENDANT FOR $4,376.20 FILED BY FORTUNE AMERICA INC/XIAN GAO PRESIDENT AS TO CROSS DEFENDANT SCHLESINGER KENNETH ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-02-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 02
